findings.claim: 10-K 稱 HVAC&R 主要市場趨勢含冷媒替代與能效法規，預期有利商用 HVAC&R；資料中心市場 FY2026 異常強勁、預期 FY2027 續強。一手文件未將替代技術列為威脅。
findings.excerpt: Trends influencing our primary HVAC&R markets include refrigerant substitution and energy efficiency requirements, both of which are expected to benefit the commercial HVAC&R markets.

findings.excerpt: Home | World News | Modine invests in liquid immersion cooling Modine invests in liquid immersion cooling 3rd January 2024 USA: Thermal management company Modine has purchased the intellectual property and other specific assets of TMGcore, a Texas-based specialist in liquid immersion cooling technology for data centres.
